name: China Traditional Chinese Medicine Holdings Co. Limited
summary: China Traditional Chinese Medicine Holdings Co. Limited, an investment holding company, engages in the research and development, production, and sale of traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) and pharmaceutical products in the People's Republic of China, Hong Kong, and internationally. It operates through four segments: Yi Fang, Tian Jiang, Tong Ji Tang, and Medi-World. The company manufactures, manages, and sells concentrated TCM granules, and TCM health care products and decoction pieces, as well as TCM finished drugs.
